name: Fire Giant Houndmaster

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description:
Metal rings woven together into a shirt, leggings, and a hood make up a suit of chainmail. Chainmail grants good protection, but it’s cumbersome, so it reduces your mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Chainmail grants +8 AC at levels 11-15, +9 AC at levels 16-20, +10 AC at levels 21-25, and +12 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Spiked chain
items.description: Eladrin duelists are thought to be the first to employ this weapon, and its combination of speed and elegance supports that theory. The spiked chain delivers raking blows from a distance. Like a whip or a flail, it can also wrap around a foe’s legs to send that enemy tumbling to the ground.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

hit.description: fire damage, and the target falls prone.

effect.description: The giant slides the target up to 2 squares.

hit.description: fire damage, and the target is restrained until the start of the giant’s next turn. While the target is restrained, the giant cannot use binding chain and the range of the giant’s spiked chain power is reduced to 1.

effect.description: Area burst 1 within 10. The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the giant’s next turn. The zone is difficult terrain for all but fire creatures. A creature that enters a square in the zone takes 10 fire damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

powers.name: Loyal Defender
powers.trigger: An enemy hits the giant with an attack while the giant is adjacent to a beast ally.

effect.description: The beast ally can make a basic attack as a free action against the triggering enemy.
